card.name: The letters SP starting a word
card.fires_on: The letters "sp" or "SP" (often capitalized, sometimes after a hyphen) when they begin a word that is still unfinished. Typical continuations are spot, spread, spinal, spiculated and sponsoring.

modes.label: Capitalized SP in headings
modes.description: All-caps "SP" opening a word in warning or title text.
modes.example: WARNING: DISTANT<< SP>>READ OF TOXIN EFFECT Postmarketing

modes.label: Lowercase sp in running text
modes.description: Lowercase "sp" starting a word in descriptions, including after a hyphen.
modes.example: the monarch, painted lady, comma, red<<-sp>>otted purple, and red admiral.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward completing the word with "ot" or "ots" (as in spot), though the suppressed tokens suggest it does not directly promote "spot" itself.
card.plain: It fires when a word has just started with the letters "sp", most strongly in all-caps headings.
